findings: Architecture uses progressive same-size child groups, per-device readers and ordered single-thread hash pipes. These are scheduling design references; no contemporary throughput measurements.
Read-size calculation rounds page-based increments, grows factor8 per generation, and caps paranoid increments at16MiB. Ordinary maximum factor derives from256MiB target.

Paranoid governor estimates memory from potential pending files in ancestor chain and remaining increment size. It explicitly admits work when active_groups is below threshold even if estimated memory exceeds available accounting. This is a progress governor, not strict memory ceiling.
mem_return releases accounted budget and unrefs group digest for active groups. Interaction with finishing release requires status/lifecycle continuation before asserting null-digest failure.
Counter notifications allocate queued work; full backlog and cancellation behavior require further reading. Fake-abort control can trigger after initial progress.
Extended-attribute write path explicitly avoids clamped partial-file scans. Cache read/admission checks remain unreviewed.
Architecture comment names Murmur shadow, while verified config/implementation use XXH3; comments alone are not algorithm evidence.
